rapport_notes: Friendly, proactively offered a with/without-packing price comparison the customer wanted.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "I'd like to check on what are your biggest concerns on your move?" — asked immediately, before any logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said "I don't really have any big concerns... just get everything there safely" — nothing substantive to dig into, so full credit applies.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "at the end of the day we will only bill you for the actual hours rendered. So let's say everything will be done in three and a half or in less than that, then you will only be paying for that"

top_strength: Asked the agenda question up front and gave a fully personalized packing-vs-no-packing estimate comparison on request.
coaching_note: Sheet 1/2 differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover) and On-Time Guarantee/Communication were never mentioned anywhere in the call.
